description: Source code for a Dining Philosophers demo using Zephyr RTOS and CMSIS-RTOS V2 APIs, demonstrating thread synchronization with mutexes or semaphores, thread priorities, and thread management.

methods.name: set_phil_state_pos
methods.description: Sets cursor position for philosopher state display, using ANSI escape codes.

methods.name: print_phil_state
methods.description: Prints the current state of a philosopher, including priority and delay.

methods.name: get_random_delay
methods.description: Calculates a pseudo-random delay based on philosopher ID and uptime.

methods.name: is_last_philosopher
methods.description: Checks if the philosopher ID is the last in the sequence.

methods.name: philosopher
methods.description: Main thread function for each philosopher, managing fork acquisition, eating, and thinking.

methods.name: new_prio
methods.description: Determines thread priority based on philosopher index and configuration.

methods.name: start_threads
methods.description: Creates and starts philosopher threads with appropriate priorities.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Program entry point, initializes demo and starts philosopher threads.
